chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah
Regarding women, if they have children, they are given one-fourth from the estate.
ai.seo_question: What is the wife's inheritance share if the husband has children?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the Quranic ruling that a wife’s share is reduced to one-fourth when her husband leaves behind descendants, a principle derived from Surah An-Nisa. In Shia jurisprudence, this narration is often cited to clarify that the presence of children (whether from this wife or another) triggers this specific reduction, distinguishing it from the one-half share applicable when no descendants exist. The chain of transmission highlights the continuity of this legal understanding through key narrators like Ibn Abi Umayr and Ibn Udhaynah.
